name: Enforce Error Handling Pattern
description: Deterministic spec validation using AST-free pattern matching. Detects functions missing parameter validation by comparing function count vs validation count.

variables.name: target_file
variables.description: Path to the file to analyze

tasks.description: Use pattern matching to detect validation gaps

prompt.template:
Run this deterministic detection script (NO LLM reasoning - just execute):

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e
mkdir -p results /tmp

TARGET="{{target_file}}"

# Detection method: Compare function count vs validation patterns
EXPORTED=$(grep -cE 'export\s+(async\s+)?function|export\s+const\s+\w+\s*=' "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
FUNC_WITH_PARAMS=$(grep -cE 'function\s+\w+\s*\([^)]+\)|=>\s*\(' "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
VALIDATION_CHECKS=$(grep -cE 'typeof\s+\w+|instanceof\s+\w+|Array\.isArray|Number\.is|\.(length|size)\s*[<>=]' "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
ERROR_THROWS=$(grep -cE 'throw\s+new\s+(Type|Range|Error)' "$TARGET" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)

# Calculate metrics
VIOLATIONS=$((FUNC_WITH_PARAMS > VALIDATION_CHECKS ? FUNC_WITH_PARAMS - VALIDATION_CHECKS : 0))
if [ "$FUNC_WITH_PARAMS" -gt 0 ]; then
  COMPLIANCE=$(echo "scale=2; $VALIDATION_CHECKS / $FUNC_WITH_PARAMS" | bc)
else
  COMPLIANCE="1.00"
fi

echo "{\"totalViolations\": $VIOLATIONS, \"timestamp\": \"$(date -Iseconds)\", \"specId\": \"error-handling\", \"compliance\": $COMPLIANCE, \"analyzed\": {\"file\": \"$TARGET\", \"exportedFunctions\": $EXPORTED, \"functionsWithParams\": $FUNC_WITH_PARAMS, \"validationChecks\": $VALIDATION_CHECKS, \"errorThrows\": $ERROR_THROWS}, \"violations\": [], \"detectionMethod\": \"grep-pattern-matching\"}" > results/specification-violations.json

cat results/specification-violations.json
```

Just run this bash script. Output will be in results/specification-violations.json.
